highlights: close to local schools and amenities
summary: Situated in the popular residential area of Beaumont Hill, this modern three bedroom detached family home offers contemporary living, with a spacious kitchen diner ideal for family meals and entertaining.
description:
KITCHEN/DINER A modern kitchen/diner fitted with a range of wall and base units, a gas hob, integrated electric oven and extractor hood. The kitchen also benefits from a sink with mixer tap and plumbing for a washer/dryer, providing a practical and functional space for everyday living.

LIVING ROOM A spacious and inviting living room overlooking the beautifully landscaped rear garden, with French doors opening directly onto the garden.

FIRST FLOOR WC A convenient ground floor WC fitted with a wash basin and radiator.

MASTER BEDROOM A spacious master bedroom enjoying a dual aspect outlook to the front and side of the property. The room benefits from a private en-suite shower room, fitted with a shower, wash basin and WC.

BEDROOM A well proportioned double bedroom enjoying a front and side aspect, with ample space for a range of freestanding bedroom furniture.

BEDROOM A versatile third bedroom, ideal for use as a guest bedroom, home office or nursery, depending on your needs.

EXTERNAL To the rear, the property boasts a beautifully landscaped garden featuring decorative white stone chippings, an attractive central feature and raised flower beds. A lawned area to the back of the garden provides additional outdoor space, alongside a dedicated seating area and garden shed.
